title: F3Lite
description: A fabric mod that replaces the F3 menu with a more user-friendly screen.
body:
# F3 Lite
F3 Lite is a Fabric Minecraft mod that replaces the default F3 debug overlay with a much simpler and user-friendly overlay, by removing a lot of information that most average players don't need.
![F3 menu with F3 Lite mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce975de538d742208d23bc16faa1098841fcd781.png)
